ValidationRule.description: [Sheet row 45 / OppVR65] Blocks BV->Booked/Setup/Closed until Deal_Validation__c='Pass'. Setup added as an applicable stage 2026-09-24 per IRM feedback.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( NOT(ISPICKVAL(Deal_Validation__c, 'Pass')),
ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), 'Booking Verification'),
OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Booked'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Setup'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Closed') ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Booking Verification is required. You cannot advance this Opportunity until Booking Verification is complete.
